read_lines_from_file: read all or a subset of lines from a text file into a list
write_lines_to_file: write a list of strings as lines to a file, creating parent directories if needed
yield_lines_in_parallel: iterate over multiple files line by line in parallel using zip_longest
lock_directory_context: acquire an exclusive file lock on a directory using a lockfile context manager
create_directory_or_skip: create a new directory with rollback on error and skip if it already exists
